clinicalSource: Among 120 adults, mortality fell from 8% to 6%; the result was not statistically significant (p=0.18). The dose remained 5 mg once daily.
alignmentSource: Researchers enrolled 120 adults. Blood pressure was measured every morning. This trial continued for six weeks.
